SPEAKER_SETUP_INTRO: To add or change a speaker, put it in pairing mode, find it, then select it below.
FIND_SPEAKERS_NOTE: Scanning takes about 12 seconds. Keep the speaker nearby and in pairing mode.
AUDIO_DESTINATION_NOTE: Choose the Bluetooth speaker or return to Volumio's normal audio output. With Mixer Type set to Hardware, Bluetooth is effectively sent at 100% and Volumio volume applies only to the DAC. Choose Software to control Bluetooth volume from Volumio.
SWITCH_OUTPUT_NOTE: Switching stops playback. Press Play when the change completes; the current track restarts from the beginning.
SAVED_SPEAKER_NOTE: Reconnect or remove the speaker already known to Volumio.
FORGET_SPEAKER_NOTE: Forgetting removes the Bluetooth pairing. Pairing mode will be required to add it again.
AUTO_RECONNECT_NOTE: Reconnects the saved speaker when it becomes available, but never changes the selected audio destination.
SCAN_NOTE: Scanning takes about 12 seconds. Audio-capable devices are listed first when BlueZ reports their profile.
VOLUME_NOTE: Software is safest initially. Speaker hardware volume may not follow Volumio volume.
CREATE_OUTPUT_NOTE: Available only when device diagnostics confirm BlueALSA. This never installs a competing audio stack or edits MPD directly.
MANUAL_OUTPUT_NOTE: Switching output stops playback. Press Play when the switch completes. Default output returns to the device already selected in Playback Options.
